items.title: AI video for technical YouTube: options, quality and cost
items.summary: A comparison of the current talking-head, slide, B-roll and voice tools for technical YouTube videos, with three pipelines and a cost model for a 10-minute video.

items.title: Brev Tree Benchmark
items.summary: Can a small model plus a tree or router match a 27B LLM on accuracy without losing speed? 77 and 196 intents (Banking77, CLINC150), a ledger of 153 hypotheses, and what survived: a three-stage chain at 93.3% accuracy and a 49 ms mean per query.

items.title: AI Boom Trajectories
items.summary: A stock-flow-consistent simulation of the US economy with an AI investment boom in it. 10,000 exported paths out of 50,000 simulated: odds of recession, market drawdowns and AI-lab distress out to 2031, checked against what markets and forecasters say.
